name: Flights
meta_title: Airlines With Military Discounts: What They Don’t Advertise
meta_description: Airline “military discounts” are rarely % off fares — the real wins are free bags and fee waivers. Delta, United, American, Southwest & more, compared.

intro: Airline "military discounts" are rarely a simple percentage off the fare. In practice the biggest savings come from published policy perks — extra free checked bags, priority boarding, and fee waivers for active-duty members, especially when traveling on orders. A few carriers also offer unpublished military fares booked by phone rather than with an online code.
